Nagraj Manjule announces biopic on India's first Olympic medalist Khashaba

Filmmaker Nagraj Manjule has announced a new Marathi sports biopic titled ‘Khashaba’. The film will focus on the life of Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav, India's first individual Olympic medalist. This marks Manjule's return to Marathi cinema after his previous success with ‘Sairat’.
